description: Agentic OS - Autonomous multi-agent operations layer running Supabase-native (Edge Functions + pg_cron + agent_* tables + Claude API). Tier-1 routine work (support triage, lifecycle nurture, content drafting) runs autonomously; all outward-facing actions are draft-first through a human approval queue (tier 2); urgent/sensitive items escalate immediately (tier 3) to an admin Command Center and email. Phase 0 builds the platform (schema, runtime, dispatcher, budget guardrails, approval executor), Phase 0.5 the admin Command Center, Phase 1 customer service + growth (nurture, prospecting/content), Phase 2 dev/maintenance + security/ops + business reporting, Phase 3 the learning loop. Full spec: tasks/prd-agentic-os.md. Prior epic (platform-hardening-v2, US-001..US-474) archived to archive/2026-07-07-platform-hardening-v2/.
